maestro_coordination.rule: Enforce strict separation of duties between Bolt, Palette, and Sentinel. Reject any meta-reports, dummy pause acknowledgments, or commits without real code improvements.

bolt.guidance: Focus on real code optimizations in build.sh. Optimize subprocess overhead in packaging and compression pipelines.

palette.guidance: No immediate active tasks. Standby for UX/accessibility audits.

sentinel.guidance: Harden neos-autoupdate.sh input sanitization, verify secure temporary file handling (avoid CWE-59), and enforce restrictive umask defaults.
